API.import: from geobc.query_context_field import QueryContextFieldConfig, QueryContextPhysicsField, GeometryQueryContext
API.config: inherits PhysFieldRoleConfig; bc_role_mode fixed actual; query_mode zero|actual, sigma .15/querydim32/querychunk4096 defaults; outer condition_dim38
API.bundle: len/shape/ndim/device/dtype/requires_grad; integer or row slice preserves B and gradients; string fields; retain_grad retains global_tensor+projected_tokens, grad proxies global_tensor
API.forward: Inherited PhysicsField.forward/response_basis/load force-mask/alpha compose; field internally appends query32 then global32, nativeIdentity102
API.query_projection: model.query_projection nn.Linear64to32, accessible for dedicated presence/finite/zero-vs-nonzero gradient checks

semantics.fixed_gaussian: masked softmax(-direct float32 squared xyz differences/(2*.15²)), no TF32 dot-product distance
semantics.pool_order: point64 -> Linear64to32 -> normalized Gaussian weighted pool -> nonaffineLN32 -> tanh
semantics.zero: compute same query branch, result*0; allocated projection/token gradient explicitly0
semantics.inputs: same canonical geometry/BC roles independent of targets and selected load; coordinates detached only for geometry/query input derivative policy
semantics.training_context: new explicit peruniqueCAD bundle every update; no mutable data_ptr cache or detach of learned contexts
semantics.effective_capacity: Actual query activation increases effective capacity; not an information-only ablation or new-method claim

parameters_and_cost.native_padding: retained official Composite padding; actual native parameter counts measured by trainer first construction
parameters_and_cost.chunking: only bounds temporaries; full Gaussian weights needed for token backward remain saved

default_config.claim: matched architecture/activation ablation; active query branch increases effective capacity; no new-method/generalization claim

conditioned_field.claim: GeoBC candidate baseline; no new-algorithm or generalization claim

decoder.precision: native TCNN FP16 computation, FP32 master parameters, float32 returned output

encoder.pooling: concatenated masked max and masked mean

conditioned_field.conditioning: existing local BC/material features followed by global geometry descriptor
conditioned_field.geometry_source: fixed normalized xyz and two target-independent canonical CAD support/load membership roles
conditioned_field.geometry_sampling: CAD-key/seed-stable sampling without replacement; masked padding for small clouds
conditioned_field.context_gradient: index_select/concatenate preserve gradients through native TCNN inputs
conditioned_field.context_training_cache: clouds only; re-encode once per unique CAD each optimizer step
conditioned_field.control: none/id retain the same decoder condition dimension and width as shape
conditioned_field.id_policy: fixed case identity codes for a diagnostic only; cannot encode unseen geometry

default_config.coefficient_source: external target-independent reference-load metadata; no files parsed here
default_config.input_layout: original38 + query32 + global32 =102 native Identity conditions; xyz separately hash-encoded
default_config.scale_policy: trainer fits one train-only RMS(u_mm) scalar; center0; same scale for all basis components and loads
default_config.physical_decode: u_mm = common_u_scale_mm * scaled_u; no per-load bias or learned scale
default_config.stress_policy: No stress output, training, scale fitting or linear stress combination in this module
default_config.linearity_scope: linear_basis only, with identical geometry and nonload BC/material/local features; load_dependent_basis need not be load-linear
default_config.role_source: same fixed canonical ver cloud nodes; support union any original25 DOF0:6; load member original25 column6
default_config.role_control: both models instantiate5-input encoder; zero masks roles only at encode_geometry; same seed/RNG/parameter layout

query_context.distance: direct FP32 coordinate differences squared, no TF32 dot distance
query_context.weights: masked softmax(-squared_distance/(2*sigma^2)); valid cloud weights sum1
query_context.pool_matmul_precision: FP32 tensors; pooling follows the trainer's high/TF32 matmul setting
query_context.order: point64 -> Linear64to32 -> Gaussian weighted pool -> non-affine LayerNorm32 -> tanh
query_context.linear_projection_before_pool: equivalent to postpool linear in exact arithmetic because weights sum1
query_context.zero_control: compute identical query context, multiply by0; projection/token gradients explicitly0
query_context.state_cache: explicit geometry-context bundle per optimizer step, no data_ptr/implicit mutable lookup

capacity_cost.native_padding_policy: retain official TCNN Composite/channel padding; actual padded decoder parameter cost recorded after native construction, not inferred from nominal widths
capacity_cost.chunking_limit: limits temporary distance buffers, not all saved weights required by token-gradient backward

native_CUDA_gradient_check: Formal trainer first step; CPU injected decoder confirms only shape/autograd interface
